title: EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte
text:
EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte

["From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte

Team — quick pulse as we kick into the 48‑hour push. Finance needs clean stage states for the forecast by EOD Wednesday. Please reply inline with one-line status and a next action for your top deals (GreenByte, Atlas Health, Aurora Labs). If a deal is moving to Commit, explicitly confirm PO/Contract ETA.

Ask:
- One-line status per deal (stage + confidence)
- If Commit, list blocker (legal/proc/prod) and owner
- Attach any one-page P&L or PO templates you plan to send to customer

I'll consolidate and send a single rollup to Finance + GreenByte procurement tomorrow morning. Short and specific here — no freeform paragraph dumps.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Revenue Enablement, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: none (please attach your artifacts in replies)", "From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte

Irene — updates below (one-line each):
- GreenByte Systems: Stage = Contract Pending (Commit, 80%); blocker = legal redline + PO needed; owner = Ben Carter. I scheduled a short call with Tom H. tomorrow to confirm signature path. Attachment: GreenByte_MarketPlay.pdf (one-pager for procurement).
- Atlas Health: Stage = Negotiation (50%); blocker = pricing appendix; owner = Marissa.
- Aurora Labs: Stage = Demo Complete (30%); blocker = product Q/A; owner = Dylan.

Next action: I'll run the legal/PO sync with Tom and pull draft PO template into the shared folder by EOD.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: GreenByte_MarketPlay.pdf (one-page response for procurement)", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte

Adding consolidated rollup and a proposed triage cadence for the next 48 hours. I created two artifacts: a short MAP and a month-end P&L snapshot that Finance requested for the commit queue.

Highlights:
- GreenByte (GB-2026-3471): earmarked for Nov commit if PO arrives by 11/25; legal has 24‑48h to review redlines; finance wants signed PO + invoice to recognize.
- Action cadence: 11/23 end-of-day: AE updates; 11/24 morning: consolidate + send to procurement; 11/25 EOD: finance decision.

I'll flag any deals that might need CFO approval. Please see attachments and confirm you can get PO/contract inputs on the timeline.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf, GreenByte_MonthEnd_P&L.xlsx", "From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Henderson <tom@greenbyte.com>, procurement@greenbyte.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte

Tom / Procurement — forwarding our internal rollup for visibility. Short version: GreenByte is queued for a late‑November commit if we can confirm PO + any remaining legal redlines by end of Thursday (11/25).

Please see the attached P&L snapshot and our one‑pager for procurement (sent by Ben). Can you confirm:
- PO timeline (expected date)
- Any internal approvers who must sign off (names/titles)
- Preferred invoice recipient and billing address

On receipt we'll route an invoice and a clean contract for signature. Appreciate a quick reply so finance can lock the recognition window.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Revenue Enablement, Redwood Inference
---

(Forwarded to procurement for PO/approval tracking.)", "From: Tom Henderson <tom@greenbyte.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenbyte.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: EOQ Stage Cleanup & Day-Two Triage — GreenByte

Irene / team — thanks for the clarity and the docs. Quick answers: 
- Procurement expects to issue a PO within 48 hours (target 11/26 close). We'll route to our legal for a last pass on the limited redline items Ben noted.
- Internal approvers: Lina Park (Head of Ops), Mark Ellis (CFO) — both are on the approval chain but should not delay the PO issuance.
- Billing: send invoice to invoices@greenbyte.com, billing address in the attached P&L is correct.

Action for Redwood: please send an updated invoice (billing to invoices@greenbyte.com) and the redline-friendly contract copy. I will confirm once procurement uploads the PO.

Tom Henderson
Director, Procurement — GreenByte Systems

Referenced links: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/GB-2026-3471
Attachments from us are fine — procurement will reference them on upload."]
